parameters.name: From
parameters.description:
The start time of the log. Only UNIX timestamps in seconds are supported. For example, 1600738962 represents 2020-09-22 09:42:42.

> If you specify **From**, you must also specify **To** or **MinutePeriod**.

parameters.name: MinutePeriod
parameters.description:
The log period. Unit: minutes.

> If you do not specify **From** or **To**, you must specify **MinutePeriod**.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page when using paging. Maximum value: **50**. Default value: **10**.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the SSL server. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~36063~~) operation to query the region ID.

parameters.name: SslVpnClientCertId
parameters.description: The ID of the SSL client certificate.

parameters.name: To
parameters.description:
The end time of the log. Only UNIX timestamps in seconds are supported. For example, 1600738962 represents 2020-09-22 09:42:42.

> If you specify **To**, you must also specify **From** or **MinutePeriod**.

parameters.name: VpnSslServerId
parameters.description: The ID of the SSL server.
